description: The server holds a request open until there is data or a timeout, then the client immediately asks again. Real-time over plain HTTP.
A long `text/event-stream` response for server-to-client messages, with automatic reconnection and `Last-Event-ID` resume.
A persistent full-duplex connection started with an HTTP upgrade. Low latency in both directions, but stateful.
Delivering one event to every interested connection, across all instances, usually through Redis pub/sub or a broker.
Periodic ping or comment messages that keep idle connections open through proxies and detect dead clients.
Routing a client's requests to the same instance. Needed by long polling fallbacks, not by a single WebSocket or SSE connection.
